user.title: Connect to EinVault
user.description: Point Home Assistant at your EinVault instance. Use the instance's local address (for example http://192.168.1.10:7387) rather than a public hostname — EinVault rate limits by client IP, and traffic arriving through a reverse proxy shares a single budget with every other consumer.

data_description.url: Base URL of your EinVault instance, without a trailing path.
data_description.api_token: Create one under Settings → API tokens. Choose full access — a write-only token cannot read any data.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate EinVault
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {url} was rejected. If you rotated it, paste the new token here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the EinVault instance. Check the address and that the container is running.
error.invalid_auth: The API token was rejected. Check that it was copied in full and has not been revoked.
error.invalid_url: That does not look like a valid URL. Include the scheme, for example http://192.168.1.10:7387.
error.api_disabled: The bearer API is turned off on this instance. Set API_TOKENS_ENABLED=true and restart the container.
error.rate_limited: EinVault is rate limiting requests right now. Wait a minute and try again.
error.write_only_token: This is a write-only token. It cannot read companions, logs, weight, or reminders, so no entities could be created. Create a token with full access instead.
error.insufficient_permissions: This token's role does not permit reading the data the integration needs. An admin or member token is recommended.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This EinVault instance is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between polls. The minimum is 60. EinVault allows 30 requests per minute per client IP, shared with every other consumer on that address.
data_description.enable_mood_sensor: Adds a mood sensor per companion. Costs one extra API request per companion on every refresh, so it is off by default.
data_description.include_archived: Create entities for companions that have been archived in EinVault.
data_description.calendar_feed_url: Optional. Paste the personal ICS feed URL from EinVault under Settings, Calendar feed. This adds a calendar per companion with full recurring-reminder support. The feed uses its own token and does not count against the API rate limit. Leave blank to create no calendars.

error.invalid_calendar_feed: That does not look like an EinVault calendar feed URL. It should end in /api/calendar/<token>/feed.ics
